description: Use this for UK lenders' current published mortgage rates, as NewHomeSearch holds them with the date each was read: each product's initial rate, follow-on rate, APRC, maximum loan to value and fees, with a link to the lender's own page; for a price and deposit, the monthly payment and APRC for that loan. Filter by fixed or tracker, deal length, first time buyer or mover, and lender. Recent rate changes too. Listed by lender, not ranked. Information only: it gives no mortgage advice, recommends no product and arranges no mortgage.

changes.description: Also list rate changes in the last five weeks.

lender.description: One lender by name, for example Nationwide.

name: mortgage_rates
title: Mortgage rates by lender
